blocks.content:
The Supreme Court is a Court of Record.

Meaning:
• Its judgments are recorded for perpetual memory.
• Can punish for contempt of court.
The Supreme Court is a Court of Record.

items: Article 129 is frequently tested regarding the Supreme Court's status as a Court of Record.
Understand the twin meanings: maintenance of records for perpetual memory and the power to punish for contempt of court.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 129 explicitly declares the Supreme Court to be a Court of Record.
Judgments and legal proceedings of the court are recorded for perpetual memory and evidentiary value.
The Supreme Court holds the inherent power to punish for contempt of court.
